title: AI Coding on iPhone and iPad | Acode
description: Use Acode’s AI Agent plugin on iPhone and iPad to work with project code. Learn about provider setup, reviewing edits, and iOS limitations.
heroHeadline: Work with an AI assistant in your iOS editor
heroSubheadline: Use the AI Agent plugin with a supported provider to ask about code and work on project changes without leaving your editor.
problemPoints: Use Acode’s AI Agent plugin on iPhone and iPad to work with project code. Learn about provider setup, reviewing edits, and iOS limitations.
solutionPoints: Acode for iPhone and iPad is currently marked Coming soon on the website. Check the home page for release availability.
featuresHeadline: AI Coding on iPhone and iPad

features.title: Choose a compatible provider
features.description: Configure a provider supported by the plugin. Available models, sign-in methods, and features depend on that provider.

features.title: Keep changes reviewable
features.description: Start with a small, specific request. Inspect proposed file changes and run the project’s checks before accepting or committing the result.

features.title: Understand access and costs
features.description: Provider requests send the context needed for your task to that service. Review its terms and pricing; an Acode account or purchase does not include every provider’s usage.

setupSteps.title: Open a project
setupSteps.description: Choose the folder you want to work on and make sure important changes are saved or committed.

setupSteps.title: Install AI Agent
setupSteps.description: Open Acode’s Plugins page, find AI Agent, and follow the plugin’s setup instructions.

setupSteps.title: Connect a provider
setupSteps.description: Configure a supported account or API key. Keep secrets out of source files and prompts.

setupSteps.title: Review the work
setupSteps.description: Ask for a focused change, inspect the result, and validate it with your project’s normal checks.

faqs.question: Is AI usage included with Acode?
faqs.answer: AI providers may require a separate account, subscription, or usage payment. Check the selected provider’s pricing before sending requests.

faqs.question: Are all terminal AI tools supported on iOS?
faqs.answer: No. Command-line tools have their own runtime requirements, and the iOS terminal uses emulation. Plugin support does not guarantee that every CLI tool will run.

faqs.question: Will an agent continue after I leave the app?
faqs.answer: iOS may suspend Acode in the background. Keep the app active while a task runs and check its status when you return.
